$comment: Documents the expected shape of a task file for the human-authored matrix in tasks/README.md. This is a schema, not a task - no scored content lives here.

id.description: unique task id, becomes part of the run directory name

prompt.description: the request text, e.g. the canonical question or a narrowed variant

setup.description: human-authored fixture/identity strategy for this task against the shared book - e.g. which deal id(s) this task owns, so cleanup only touches records the test itself created

expect.description: what the human-authored verifier checks - postconditions in the live database, not the run artifact's own claims
